summary: A hand-entered vector read in Excel at a coarser period now comes back as figures instead of a configuration error.
details: Reading a monthly hand-entered vector a year at a time asked the data engine to build it, which it cannot do for figures that were typed in, so the cell showed a data processing configuration error instead of the numbers.
The yearly reading is now added up from the stored figures the same way a method already reads the same vector, and nothing is written beside them.
The same blindness meant a hand-entered vector was not recognised as hand-entered at all, so a read could clear the only copy of its figures before failing.
